CREDITS
✕
An open-world pixel action game. Explore Bone Shore, Frost & Ember and the Underworld, hunt the bosses, clear the Boss Fight stages, complete the unlock quests and level up all six Elemental Ninjas.

Character and enemy models: original pixel art by the game's author. Everything else — maps, effects, UI and sound — is drawn and synthesized in code inside this single file. No external assets.
